items.title: Breakfast Nook
items.body: At the back of the house beside the Kitchen, with two walls of windows and a door out to the backyard deck. The pantry is a few steps away, so breakfast stays close to the stove and the yard is just outside.

items.title: Fenced Backyard
items.body: A fenced yard behind the house, with a covered patio along one side and a covered garage at the back. Steps from the nook deck lead down to the yard, and a new driveway runs along the side to the garage.

cover.house: A bungalow in the East End with a board and batten gable over the front porch, set back behind a new walk. The big work is done: a reworked, leveled and braced foundation under new wiring, new plumbing and a new roof, with Hardi Plank siding outside and an all new kitchen and two all new baths inside. It has never flooded.

back.title: The Property, in Plan
back.planNote: Room names and sizes match the captions inside.

photos.title: Covered Patio and Covered Garage
photos.body: The 9 x 26 covered patio sits beside a 14 x 24 covered garage in the fenced yard. Park under the roof, set up a workshop on the three-phase power, or leave the patio open for a table and chairs.

photos.title: Hall Bath Shelves
photos.body: Open shelves for towels and linens line the wall beside the vanity in the hall bath, a few steps from Bedrooms 2 and 3. The tub has a full surround in marble-look tile, matching the Primary Bath.

back.note: The foundation was reworked, leveled and braced before anything else. Then came all new wiring, a new breaker box and three-phase power. New plumbing, a new roof and Hardi Plank siding followed, so the systems you cannot see were done with the finishes you can.

left.kicker: Inside · The front of the house
left.title: Living, Dining and Kitchen
left.intro: The front door opens into the Living Room, and a wide cased opening joins it to the Dining Area and Kitchen. The pantry and the Breakfast Nook sit just around the corner from the Kitchen, so the front of the house works as one open space.

photos.title: Living Room
photos.body: It faces the street, with a tall window to the front and a clerestory window set high on the wall that adds daylight and keeps privacy. A wide cased opening leads on through the Dining Area and into the Kitchen, over wood-look floors the whole way.

photos.title: Dining Area
photos.body: Between the Kitchen peninsula and the hall to the bedrooms. Two pendant lights hang over the peninsula beside it.

photos.title: From the Dining Area
photos.body: The view runs to the front door and the Living Room on one side and to the Kitchen peninsula and its two pendant lights on the other, with no doors or steps between them.

photos.title: Kitchen
photos.body: All new, laid out in an L with a peninsula, white shaker uppers and stainless steel appliances. The range, sink and dishwasher sit a step apart, with the pantry just around the corner.

photos.title: Front Entry
photos.body: Wood-look floors run from the front door straight to the Kitchen, with no thresholds between rooms.

photos.title: Breakfast Nook
photos.body: Windows on two walls, right beside the Kitchen, with the backyard in view and the pantry close by.

photos.title: Kitchen from the Hall
photos.body: Looking from the bedroom hall across the peninsula, with the range and the navy lower cabinets beyond.

right.title: Beyond the Dining Area
right.intro: Past the Dining Area, a hall leads to the Primary and two more bedrooms. Bedrooms 2 and 3 share the hall bath, which also serves guests, so the Primary Bath stays private. The Primary sits at the rear of the house, away from the street, with the garage beside it.

photos.title: Primary Bedroom
photos.body: A vaulted ceiling with an exposed painted beam, windows on two walls and a double-door closet, in the rear corner away from the street. It fits a king bed and a long dresser, with the Primary Bath through a doorway on the closet wall.

photos.title: Under the Vault
photos.body: The same vaulted ceiling and exposed painted beam, from the far side of the Primary, looking toward the closet doors.

photos.title: Primary Bath
photos.body: Double sinks on a dark navy vanity let two people get ready at once, under an LED backlit mirror.

photos.title: Primary Shower
photos.body: Tiled floor to ceiling in marble-look tile, with a glass door, a rain showerhead and a handheld.

photos.title: Primary Closet
photos.body: Double doors open to a built-in shelving tower with rods on both sides and shelves above. It stays.

photos.title: Bedroom 2
photos.body: The larger of the two secondary bedrooms, in a front corner, with a window on each outside wall.

photos.title: Bedroom 3
photos.body: The closet is on the hall side, so the window wall stays open for a desk or a dresser. It sits next to the Primary.

photos.title: Hall Bath
photos.body: A tub with full-height marble-look tile, a pebble tile niche and a window above it, a few steps from Bedroom 2.
